reason: Severe Zellweger disease defines metabolic and neurologic axes; common hepatic and ocular dysfunction reasonably fill the cap. Renal and hearing manifestations are acknowledged as omitted.
Subcutaneous edema and pleural/pericardial fluid accumulation are defining manifestations. Haematologic and immune causes are subtype-specific and do not define the umbrella.
Drug-induced osteoporosis directly affects bone. Neither an endocrine disorder nor a distinct systemic metabolic disorder is required; the parent's label alone does not justify another axis.
Subcutaneous fat loss and metabolic dysfunction define the disorder. Hepatic steatosis in 2/2 patients with elevated transaminases supports common functional hepatic involvement.
Add cardiovascular to primary: ectasia of superficial dermal capillaries defines angiokeratoma, and capillaries are explicitly within that axis. Dermatologic remains primary for the cutaneous lesion.

corrected.basis: Angiokeratoma consists of ectatic superficial dermal capillaries with overlying epidermal hyperkeratosis; genital skin location does not make it purely reproductive.

reason: A lymphoid malignancy warrants haematologic and infectious_immune. Testicular location does not establish a disease of hormone-producing gonadal tissue; the sex cord-stromal ancestry is misleading.

The metabolic defect is primary. Cerebral atrophy/regression, optic atrophy and hearing impairment each occur in the reported patient and support the involved axes; secondary aspiration does not establish direct lung disease.
The disease is defined by retinal dysfunction. Broad nervous-system ancestry does not justify neurologic labeling when the affected structures belong to the ocular axis.
Paralytic episodes, developmental impairment and seizures establish neurologic disease. Abnormal eye movements do not demonstrate separate ocular tissue damage.

Structural skeletal muscle disease defines the condition. Respiratory and swallowing dysfunction arise from muscle weakness; pulmonary hypoplasia and cardiomyopathy are below 30%, and neural damage is not established.
